rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who drives out evil spirits or demons.

example.english: The priest called an exorcist to help drive the evil spirit out of the boy.
example.traditional: 神父請咗驅魔人嚟幫個男仔驅邪。
example.jyutping: san4 fu6 cing2 zo2 keoi1 mo1 jan4 lai4 bong1 go3 naam4 zai2 keoi1 ce4

rows.note: Use this when the exorcist is a religious ritual specialist performing ceremonies or 法事.

example.english: The exorcist performed a ritual at our home to drive the ghost away.
example.traditional: 法師喺屋企做法事，幫我哋驅走隻鬼。
example.jyutping: faat3 si1 hai2 uk1 kei2 zou6 faat3 si6 bong1 ngo5 dei6 keoi1 zau2 zek3 gwai2

rows.note: Use this colloquial, informal term for a typically male ghost-catcher, especially in popular or fictional contexts.

example.english: The exorcist in the movie is always carrying a compass around to catch ghosts.
example.traditional: 套戲入面個捉鬼佬成日帶住部羅盤周圍捉鬼。
example.jyutping: tou3 hei3 jap6 min6 go3 zuk1 gwai2 lou2 seng4 jat6 daai2 zyu6 bou6 lo4 pun4 zau1 wai4 zuk1 gwai2
